brands.name: Yokohama
brands.description: As the official importer of Yokohama tyres in Pakistan, J. Rashid & Sons brings world-class Japanese engineering and advanced rubber compounds to Pakistani roads.

about.heading: The Yokohama Story
about.history: The Yokohama Rubber Company, Limited was established in 1917 as a joint venture between Yokohama Cable Manufacturing and B.F. Goodrich. Over the past century, Yokohama has grown into a global leader in tire technology, renowned for its high-performance tires, motorsports pedigree, and cutting-edge rubber compounds.

brands.name: Goodyear
brands.slogan: MADE TO FEEL GOOD & BUILT TO LAST
brands.description: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company is one of the world's largest tyre companies. J. Rashid & Sons provides authentic Goodyear tyres for passenger cars, SUVs, and commercial vehicles.

about.heading: The Goodyear Heritage
about.history: Founded in 1898 by Frank Seiberling, The Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company was named after Charles Goodyear, the inventor of vulcanized rubber. Today, Goodyear is one of the world's largest tire companies, celebrated for its innovations in aviation, motorsports, and everyday consumer driving.

brands.name: Warrior
brands.description: Warrior tyres are built tough for Pakistani road conditions. Designed for durability and performance at competitive prices.

about.heading: The Warrior Legacy
about.history: With a heritage dating back to the 1920s in Shanghai, Warrior Tyres is one of China's most historic and respected domestic tire brands. Backed by joint ventures with global tire giants over the decades, Warrior combines century-old manufacturing experience with modern European and Asian tire technology.

brands.name: Atlas Tyre
brands.description: Atlas Tyres deliver superior traction and durability for a wide range of vehicles, ensuring a safe and comfortable ride across Pakistan.

about.heading: The Atlas Tradition
about.history: Established in 1935 as the official tire brand of Standard Oil service stations across the United States, Atlas has long been a symbol of American automotive reliability. Today, Atlas continues to deliver exceptional quality, durability, and value for passenger cars and commercial vehicles globally.

brands.name: Risen
brands.description: Risen Tyres provide exceptional value and reliable performance, designed specifically to tackle tough road conditions with ease.

about.heading: The Risen Innovation
about.history: Risen Tyre represents the new wave of modern Chinese tire manufacturing. Utilizing state-of-the-art automated production lines and advanced tread design technologies, Risen focuses on eco-friendly, fuel-efficient, and highly durable tires that meet strict international safety standards.

brands.name: Falken
brands.description: Falken is known for its high-performance tires, offering precision handling and superior grip for sports cars and everyday driving.

about.heading: The Falken Journey
about.history: Launched in 1983 as a flagship high-performance brand under Sumitomo Rubber Industries, Falken was created to challenge the world's most demanding motorsports arenas. Falken has since transformed that track-tested technology into premium passenger, light truck, and SUV tires for the global market.

products.name: Yokohama BluEarth AE51
products.description: The BluEarth AE51 combines eco-friendly performance with excellent wet grip. Advanced silica compound for reduced rolling resistance and improved fuel economy. Featuring Yokohama's orange oil technology for enhanced grip and lower environmental impact.

products.name: Yokohama ADVAN A052
products.description: The ADVAN A052 is your race-ready, extreme performance summer tire that delivers physics-defying levels of grip, making a statement on the street and a standout on the track.

products.name: Yokohama ADVAN Neova AD09
products.description: The next generation in legendary street/track performance. A specialized tread pattern provides rapid water evacuation for superior wet grip and control.

products.name: Yokohama ADVAN Apex V601
products.description: An ultra-high performance summer tire born from Yokohama's legendary performance tire heritage. Optimized contact patch for maximum grip.

products.name: Yokohama ADVAN A055
products.description: Built specifically for on-track racing with competitive performance and fast lap times, the ADVAN A055 is the latest addition to Yokohama's decades-long legacy of UHP tires.

products.name: Yokohama ADVAN Sport V107
products.description: The flagship ADVAN Sport V107 provides the ultimate blend of precision steering response, incredible grip, and exceptional stability at high speeds.

products.name: Yokohama Geolandar A/T G015
products.description: All-terrain performance meets on-road comfort. Triple polymer tread compound delivers outstanding traction on any surface. Perfect for SUV drivers who need both highway comfort and off-road capability.

products.name: Yokohama TY517
products.description: Premium commercial drive tyre with deep tread design for extended mileage. Engineered for long-haul operations with superior fuel efficiency.

products.name: Goodyear Assurance TripleMax 2
products.description: HydroTred Technology for superior wet braking. DuraGrip Technology for longer tyre life. Perfect for Pakistani city driving with enhanced safety features.

products.name: Goodyear Wrangler AT/SA+
products.description: Versatile all-terrain tyre with aggressive tread pattern. Self-cleaning grooves for off-road confidence. Ideal for Pakistani terrain.

products.name: Goodyear KMAX S
products.description: Steer axle truck tyre with optimized footprint shape for even wear and long tread life. Built for commercial fleets.

products.name: Michelin Primacy 4 ST
products.description: Premium touring tyre with EverGrip Technology. New when worn - maintains performance throughout its life. The benchmark in premium comfort.

products.name: Michelin Latitude Sport 3
products.description: High-performance SUV tyre combining sportiness with comfort. Green X technology for fuel efficiency. Premium handling and braking.

products.name: Blackarrow Touring Plus
products.description: Reliable all-season tyre with optimized tread pattern for comfortable daily driving in Pakistan. Excellent value for money.

products.name: Blackarrow Sport GT
products.description: Performance-oriented tyre with aggressive tread design. Enhanced cornering stability and responsive handling for spirited driving.

products.name: Warrior All Terrain X
products.description: Built for the toughest Pakistani roads. Reinforced sidewalls and deep tread lugs for maximum durability and off-road confidence.

products.name: Warrior Highway Master
products.description: Smooth, quiet highway tyre with excellent fuel economy. Low rolling resistance compound for long-distance comfort.
